headline: Fresh Base Shifts Mark Contested Fronts
war_summary: Since the last edition, the unsettled map has grown more fluid. Nevish Line, previously all eight bases Warden-held, now lists five Warden, two Colonial and one unheld. Linn Mercy has shifted from ten Colonial-held bases and one unheld to eight and three, while Marban Hollow stands at four Warden, three Colonial and one unheld, against two, three and three before. Weathered Expanse is now three Warden, two Colonial and four unheld, another change from four, one and four. The event ledgers show these fronts still turning: Nevish recorded 15 rows in the last two hours, Linn four and Weathered three; rows may record both sides of a single change. Marban logged one recent row. Mooring County remains wholly Warden-held but registered an event in two hours and seven in six. Stonecradle, still seven Colonial bases to two Warden, has had no event rows in six hours despite a sharp rise in reported casualties. Kuura Strand has also gone quiet, with no event rows in six hours and all six bases Colonial-held. War 140 remains undecided; 34 victory towns are required.
